'''Goh's Farfetch'd''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのカモネギ''' ''Go's Kamonegi'') is the twenty-fifth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his thirty-eighth overall.

==History==
==={{aniseries|JN}}===
[[File:Goh and Farfetch'd.png|thumb|left|250px|Farfetch'd and Goh]]
[[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} Farfetch'd in ''[[JN020|Dreams Are Made of These!]]'' while he was participating in a [[Pokémon Orienteering]] competition. During his first two attempts to catch it, Farfetch'd deflected the thrown {{i|Poké Ball}}s with its leek. During the third attempt, Goh faked it out and caught it while its guard was down.

In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', Farfetch'd was one of the Pokémon that suffered from a lack of food at the [[Cerise Laboratory]]. Though it resisted the urge to eat its leek, Goh's other Pokémon wanted to eat it, which made it fly away in a hurry. In the end, Farfetch'd joined the Laboratory's other Pokémon to help Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}} [[Evolution|evolve]] safely into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}}.

In ''[[JN027|Toughing It Out!]]'', Goh started {{pkmn|training}} Farfetch'd. To this end, he took it on a trip to the [[Galar]] [[region]] so it could watch a [[World Coronation Series]] battle between {{an|Leon}} and [[Raihan]]. When {{Ash}} and Goh encountered a {{rf|Galarian}} {{AP|Farfetch'd}}, Goh used Farfetch'd against it in an attempt to capture it. Despite its best efforts, Goh's Farfetch'd was defeated. [[JN028|The next day]], Ash and Goh's Pokémon got together to eat breakfast at the [[Wyndon]] [[Pokémon Center]]. However, when everyone's food started to disappear, Farfetch'd joined the others to find the culprit, who ultimately turned out to be a {{TP|Goh|Sobble}}.

In ''[[JN030|Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!]]'', Goh used Farfetch'd in a {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}}'s {{AP|Riolu}}. Despite the type advantage, Farfetch'd was defeated without much effort.

In ''[[JN032|Time After Time!]]'', Goh used Farfetch'd along with {{TP|Goh|Scyther}} to break through the [[Ilex Forest]]. Along the way, Goh managed to capture an {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Ariados}} and a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Pineco}} at the same time, triggering some memories of Goh with his childhood friend [[Horace]]. Farfetch'd was present with Goh and his other Pokémon when he finally managed to see Horace again.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Farfetch'd attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Ash and Goh Farfetch'd.png|thumb|250px|Facing its regional form]]
In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', it was revealed that Farfetch'd is aligned with the group of Goh's Pokémon who prefer to rest next to {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}. When Golurk's seal broke, Farfetch'd and the other Pokémon in its group worked together to try to calm the [[giant Pokémon]] down. Despite its reluctance to be {{pkmn2|caught}} in [[JN020|its debut]], Farfetch'd quickly grew close to Goh, to the point where it gladly followed him to the [[Galar]] [[region]] to watch the match between [[Raihan]] and {{an|Leon}}. Goh's Farfetch'd appears to have a mutual rivalry with [[Ash's Farfetch'd|Ash's own Farfetch'd]]. While the two are normally friendly towards each other, they are prone to bickering, which leads to them clashing with their leeks.

As is common in its species, Farfetch'd is quite protective of its leek. While it briefly considered eating its leek during the food shortage in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', it quickly decided against it, and fled before Goh's {{TP|Goh|Taillow}} and {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Spearow}} had the chance to do the same. Farfetch'd appears to have a talent for deflecting projectiles, using its leek like a baseball bat to send them back. This made capturing it difficult for Goh, who had to fake it out before throwing. In ''[[JN027|Toughing It Out!]]'', Goh was seen {{pkmn|training}} Farfetch'd by developing this special talent.
